name: Matching habitat restoration grants
summary: Annual matching grants of up to $5,000 for projects that physically restore or enhance cold-water stream and fish habitat. Local conservation organisations apply; volunteer labour can count as match.
reporting: Recipients submit an annual status report on their project when asked.

calls.recurring: Proposals must arrive before 1 August each year; the review is held each September.
